summary: Frontend-only regression test after logo-sizing bug fix and perf optimisation (React.lazy + IntersectionObserver Reveal). Verified logo renders at correct 1.18 aspect ratio in all placements, all 11 public lazy routes render with 200 + content, admin login + dashboard works, scroll-reveal animations resolve to opacity 1, and the full 5-step booking flow completes with booking-confirmation + order number + access code.

issues: Radix DialogContent accessibility warning: missing DialogTitle and aria-describedby on the mobile nav Sheet. Non-blocking, but a11y warning in console. Wrap a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle inside SheetContent.

scroll_reveal: Elements with .ss-reveal that enter viewport receive .ss-reveal-in and reach opacity 1 (verified 1/1 in-viewport element visible after scroll). No elements left permanently hidden.
booking_flow: Completed Step 1 (service+pairs) -> Step 2 (5 photo uploads) -> Step 3 (shoe details) -> Step 4 (customer details, postcode SW1A 2AA) -> Step 5 (review) -> submit. Received toast 'Order SS-10001 submitted for assessment!' and the data-testid=booking-confirmation page with order number SS-10001 and 32-char access code.
action_items: Low priority a11y: add VisuallyHidden <DialogTitle> inside mobile Sheet to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Logo.jsx now correctly relies on className only; naturalWidth 1092 confirms full-res asset loads, ratio preserved everywhere.
Reveal.jsx IntersectionObserver falls back to setShown(true) when IO is undefined — good SSR/old-browser safeguard.

PhotoUploader buttons expose data-testid on the trigger <button>, not the hidden <input type=file>. Automated tests must select the sibling input. Consider adding a data-testid on the file input too for easier testing.
seed_data_creation: Created order SS-10001 (TEST data via booking flow) with test_user@example.com. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Logo bug fix verified. Public lazy routes + admin dashboard + full 5-step booking flow all green. Only outstanding minor: Radix Dialog a11y warning on mobile Sheet (missing DialogTitle). Previous iterations 1-5 covered broader scope; this run focused on perf-optimisation regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Logo.jsx had hardcoded width/height attributes (1092/922) that overrode the Tailwind height-only classes, stretching the header logo to full intrinsic width. Fix (verified): remove width/height HTML attributes so className controls size and the browser preserves intrinsic aspect ratio. Confirmed all logos now render at ratio 1.18 across header (desktop + mobile), hero, footer, and mobile Sheet.
